## Product summary

Discovery Program is an AI-native commercial development discovery platform for Nucleate NY BioHack 2026 (Track 02 Autonomous Research, Pfizer Commercial Development Discovery).

Input: patient cohort CSV + clinical question + org context.
Output: ranked discovery programs with trust scores, TPP blueprints, IND roadmaps, regulatory provenance.
Differentiator: cohort-first cross-domain mining with live PubMed/trials/patents/Open Targets queries — not taxonomy-bound expert search.

Tagline: Find what experts don't know to look for.
Live demo: https://arclightbio.vercel.app
Repo: https://github.com/nayanikar/arclightbio
Sample completed program: https://arclightbio.vercel.app/opportunity/09c1f4cd-1698-4853-b4fc-9d1f0dffbb64

## Verify claims in code

| Claim | Path |
|-------|------|
| V3 pipeline orchestration (canonical) | src/lib/blackboardRunV3.ts |
| Phase 1 agents | src/agents/phase1/ |
| Phase 2 agents | src/agents/phase2/ |
| Program trust score | src/lib/programTrustScore.ts |
| Undruggable registry | src/lib/undruggableRegistry.ts |
| Live PubMed | src/api/pubmed.ts |
| Live ClinicalTrials.gov | src/api/clinicalTrials.ts |
| Live Open Targets | src/api/openTargets.ts |
| Live Lens patents | src/api/lens.ts |
| Live OpenFDA | src/api/openFda.ts |
| Persistence | src/lib/v3Db.ts, src/lib/db.ts |
| Agent audit trail | src/lib/agentTrail.ts |
| Types | src/types/V3Pipeline.ts, src/types/OpportunityObject.ts |
| Marketing copy | src/components/home/homeCopy.ts |
| Discover UI | src/app/discover/page.tsx |
| Program page UI | src/components/opportunity/OpportunityPageV3.tsx |
| Regulatory PDF | src/lib/regulatoryPdf.ts |
| Cohort parser | src/lib/cohortParser.ts |
| RLS migration | supabase/migrations/022_enable_rls.sql |

## Verification scripts

```bash
npm test                                    # 18 unit test files
npx tsx scripts/verify-v3-spec.ts           # static V3 compliance
node scripts/run-v3-discovery-e2e.mjs       # headless pipeline (~30-45 min, needs API keys)
npm run capture-marketing [id] --base URL   # screenshot regeneration
```

## Routes

- / — marketing home
- /discover — launch discovery (cohort + query required)
- /dashboard — portfolio queue with trust scores
- /opportunity/[id] — live discovery program page
- /undruggable — cross-session undruggable registry
- /opportunity/[id]/regulatory — regulatory assembly + PDF
- /admin — admin panel

## API routes

- /api/discover, /api/discover/classify
- /api/opportunities, /api/opportunities/metrics
- /api/opportunity/[id], /api/opportunity/[id]/status, /api/opportunity/[id]/trail
- /api/opportunity/[id]/pause, /resume, /revise, /add-data, /phase2-hypothesis
- /api/stream/[id], /api/blackboard/[id]
- /api/undruggable, /api/regulatory/[id]
- /api/surveillance, /api/surveillance/[id], /api/surveillance/[id]/stream
- /api/admin/backfill, /api/admin/regenerate-tags, /api/admin/stop-pipeline, /api/admin/stop-surveillance
- /api/health (dev only — 404 in production)
- /api/spacebase/observatory (local Spacebase only)

## Quick commands

```bash
cd arclightbio && npm install && npm run dev
npm test
npx tsx scripts/verify-v3-spec.ts
node scripts/run-v3-discovery-e2e.mjs
npm run capture-marketing 09c1f4cd-1698-4853-b4fc-9d1f0dffbb64 --base https://arclightbio.vercel.app
```
